digest.component_or_area: rebar._store.sync — reconverge union merge abort recovery
propositions: Reconverge fails when git merge aborts due to local working-tree changes (deletions or modifications) to tracked store artifacts, stranding local commits off origin and blocking advancement.

The recovery mechanism must detect the 'Your local changes to the following files would be overwritten by merge' abort signature, parse the named paths, and handle deletions via git checkout --HEAD and modifications by quarantining bytes then restoring.
Worktree modifications named by the abort must be preserved byte-for-byte in the reconverge-quarantine directory before the merge is unblocked via restore and retry.
Genuine merge conflicts (both sides committing different content) must retain the existing abort-keep-local-hint behavior and not trigger the local-changes recovery path.
